name: pathshim v0.1.5
body:
## New Features

- Introduces best-effort userspace bind-path mapping for ordinary Kubernetes Pods without privileged mode, extra capabilities, FUSE, or mount namespaces.
- Supports repeatable replace-style `SOURCE:DEST` mappings, overlapping destinations with longest-prefix selection, and shared physical sources across independent invocations.
- Adds guest working-directory projection plus mapped `execve`/`execveat` support for readable ELF binaries.
- Adds `pathshim probe` for startup capability detection, `--quiet` for integrations, and stable version reporting.
- Adapts at runtime between `bind-view` and `passthrough` so command startup remains available when projection capabilities are blocked.

## Bug Fixes

- Preserves the caller's process group and command signal exit semantics while forwarding common termination signals.
- Creates missing guest working directories and validates mapped startup paths consistently.

Full changes since project bootstrap: https://github.com/compforge/pathshim/compare/3657035...v0.1.5
